subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Tick all the boxes

options.text: To make a bad situation worse

solution:
The correct answer is **To fulfill the required norms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate** meaning for the given idiom '**Tick all the boxes**' is '**To fulfill the required norms**
